work_blocks_minutes_range.name: work_blocks_minutes_range
work_blocks_minutes_range.value: "work_blocks"."start_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "work_blocks"."end_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "work_blocks"."start_minute" <> "work_blocks"."end_minute"

daily_checkins_shift_minutes_range.name: daily_checkins_shift_minutes_range
daily_checkins_shift_minutes_range.value: ("daily_checkins"."shift_start_minute" is null or "daily_checkins"."shift_start_minute" between 0 and 1439) and ("daily_checkins"."shift_end_minute" is null or "daily_checkins"."shift_end_minute" between 0 and 1439)

daily_checkins_shift_hours.name: daily_checkins_shift_hours
daily_checkins_shift_hours.value: case when "daily_checkins"."work_shift" in ('morning', 'afternoon', 'night') then "daily_checkins"."shift_start_minute" is not null and "daily_checkins"."shift_end_minute" is not null and "daily_checkins"."shift_start_minute" <> "daily_checkins"."shift_end_minute" else "daily_checkins"."shift_start_minute" is null and "daily_checkins"."shift_end_minute" is null end

weekly_reviews_proposal.name: weekly_reviews_proposal
weekly_reviews_proposal.value: ("weekly_reviews"."kcal_delta" is null and "weekly_reviews"."from_kcal" is null and "weekly_reviews"."to_kcal" is null) or ("weekly_reviews"."kcal_delta" <> 0 and "weekly_reviews"."kcal_delta" between -300 and 300 and "weekly_reviews"."from_kcal" > 0 and "weekly_reviews"."to_kcal" > 0)

weekly_reviews_status.name: weekly_reviews_status
weekly_reviews_status.value: case when "weekly_reviews"."status" = 'no_change' then "weekly_reviews"."kcal_delta" is null else "weekly_reviews"."kcal_delta" is not null end

food_servings_select_all.name: food_servings_select_all
food_servings_select_all.using: exists (select 1 from "foods" f where f.id = "food_servings"."food_id" and (f.owner_id is null or f.owner_id = (select auth.uid())))

foods_owner_barcode_key.name: foods_owner_barcode_key
foods_owner_barcode_key.where: "foods"."owner_id" is not null and "foods"."barcode" is not null

foods_nutrients_non_negative.name: foods_nutrients_non_negative
foods_nutrients_non_negative.value: "foods"."kcal_100g" >= 0 and "foods"."protein_g_100g" >= 0 and "foods"."carbs_g_100g" >= 0 and "foods"."fat_g_100g" >= 0 and ("foods"."fiber_g_100g" is null or "foods"."fiber_g_100g" >= 0)

meal_items_nutrients_non_negative.name: meal_items_nutrients_non_negative
meal_items_nutrients_non_negative.value: "meal_items"."kcal" >= 0 and "meal_items"."protein_g" >= 0 and "meal_items"."carbs_g" >= 0 and "meal_items"."fat_g" >= 0 and ("meal_items"."fiber_g" is null or "meal_items"."fiber_g" >= 0)

planned_meal_items_nutrients_non_negativ.name: planned_meal_items_nutrients_non_negative
planned_meal_items_nutrients_non_negativ.value: "planned_meal_items"."kcal" >= 0 and "planned_meal_items"."protein_g" >= 0 and "planned_meal_items"."carbs_g" >= 0 and "planned_meal_items"."fat_g" >= 0 and ("planned_meal_items"."fiber_g" is null or "planned_meal_items"."fiber_g" >= 0)

exercises_name_length.name: exercises_name_length
exercises_name_length.value: length("exercises"."name_es") between 1 and 80 and length("exercises"."name_en") between 1 and 80

planned_workouts_name_length.name: planned_workouts_name_length
planned_workouts_name_length.value: "planned_workouts"."name" is null or length("planned_workouts"."name") between 1 and 60

planned_workouts_kind_fields.name: planned_workouts_kind_fields
planned_workouts_kind_fields.value: ("planned_workouts"."kind" = 'gym' and "planned_workouts"."activity" is null and "planned_workouts"."is_match" = false) or ("planned_workouts"."kind" <> 'gym' and "planned_workouts"."minutes" is not null)

program_exercises_reps_range.name: program_exercises_reps_range
program_exercises_reps_range.value: ("program_exercises"."reps_min" is null and "program_exercises"."reps_max" is null) or ("program_exercises"."reps_min" between 1 and 100 and "program_exercises"."reps_max" between "program_exercises"."reps_min" and 100)

workouts_name_length.name: workouts_name_length
workouts_name_length.value: "workouts"."name" is null or length("workouts"."name") between 1 and 60
